page.overview:
Who is Akakievich's Soldier?

One of the Soldiers at the ICBM base in Kazakhstan was a fictional unnamed man who appeared briefly in the 1999 James Bond film, The World Is Not Enough. The actor or stuntman who played him remains unknown.

Serving under the direct command of Colonel Akakievich, this soldier accompanies his superior (together with another soldier) when he confronts Bond inside the old missile silo. He aims his Makarov PM at Bond and tells him to get on his knees. When Colonel Akakievich decides to check everybody found inside the silo, Renard and his henchmen open fire, killing the Colonel and the second soldier in the progress.

Bond uses the distraction to kick this soldier and take away his Makarov. Renard uses his FN P90 submachine gun to shoot the soldier's leg. When he gets up again, he is killed by a burst from another P90, this time fired by Renard's Kazakhstan Henchman 1.
